findings: Pipeline:7x7 mean filter, shrink32x32, matrix transform, crop8x8, median threshold,64bit pack. Candidate descriptor only; no byte equality confirmation, scan/index/cache/error completeness API.

shrink source uses i*(rows/m),j*(cols/n). Below32, division step becomes0 and repeats original row/column0. Nonmultiples discard tails; no interpolation or antialiasing in shrink itself. Source arithmetic finding, no Futhark execution.

mean_filter extended-coordinate upper-edge condition i+3>=x_rows compares padded index with original dimension. For10rows, extended index7 selects original9, whereas ordinary edge extension selects4. Same issue columns. Source arithmetic finding; output impact not runtime-qualified.

Transform matrix formula cos((2*i*j+1)*pi/64) differs from DCT-II cos((2*j+1)*i*pi/64), including DC normalization. Not accepted as compatible pHash/DCT oracle; no original runtime or numerical library comparison claimed.

test-harness.py prints three hash values with no assertions, distances, expected values or retrieval threshold. Futhark inline crop/shrink examples specify two expected outputs, while400x400 hash benchmark uses auto output. None executed.

Benchmark compares imageio grayscale loading+numpy+f32 hash against Pillow open+imagehash.phash including different conversion/resize/DCT recipes;100 iterations summed seconds times10 is average milliseconds. No timings collected or speedup accepted.
